macros.name: crtcrefcountervalue
macros.doc: This extracts the counter value (or something that is stored by \cref@currentlabel belonging to a certain label name and can be used in any context that requrires integer values.

macros.name: crtcrefnumber
macros.doc: This extracts the counter value (or something that is stored by \cref@currentlabel belonging to a certain label name.

macros.name: crtcrefreference
macros.doc: This extracts the reference that would be printed by \cref or \Cref, without hyperlinks.

macros.name: crtcrefresult
macros.doc: This extracts the result of the splitting of a counter belonging to a certain label name.

macros.name: crtcrefundefinedcountervalue
macros.doc: This command sets the output of \crt@crefundefinedcountervalue in the same manner like the standard macro \title would do for \@title.

macros.name: crtextractcref
macros.doc: This command will extract one of the properties counter, number, result, reference and page from the label given as the 2nd mandatory argument.

macros.name: crtextractref
macros.doc: This command will extract one of the properties reference, page, anchor, name and unused from the label given as the 2nd mandatory argument.

macros.name: crthyperCref
macros.doc: This generates a linked reference to a given label like \Cref would do.

macros.name: crtifdefinedlabel
macros.doc: This checks whether the label ’label name’ is defined and executes the true branch, otherwise the false branch.

macros.name: crtifundefinedlabel
macros.doc: This checks whether the label ’label name’ is undefined and executes the true branch, otherwise the false branch.

macros.name: crtlistoflabelsstructurelevel
macros.doc: This changes the level of the label entries in the list of labels.

macros.name: crtlnameref
macros.doc: This generates a linked reference to the name like \nameref would do, but the first character is used in lower case mode.

macros.name: crtpostlabelhook
macros.doc: This hook is executed after the internally stored \label is called, the argument can be ’anything’.

macros.name: crtprelabelhook
macros.doc: This hook is executed before the internally stored \label is called, the argument can be ’anything’.

macros.name: crtprovidecurrentlabelinfo
macros.doc: This is a convenience macro in order to provide both \@currentlabel and \@currentlabelname at once.

macros.name: crtrefcounter
macros.doc: This macro tries to extract the counter name related to the label assuming that the standard anchor type is used: X.Y where X stands for the counter name and Y is some alphanumerical value constructed from \theHX, e.g. \theHchapter.

macros.name: crtrefname
macros.doc: This extracts the name of the sectioning unit or counter as being specified with \nameref.

macros.name: crtrefnumber
macros.doc: This extracts the reference value (or something that is stored by \@currentlabel belonging to a certain label name.

macros.name: crtrefundefinedtext
macros.doc: This command sets the output of \crt@refundefined in the same manner like the standard macro \title would do for \@title.

macros.name: crtunameref
macros.doc: This generates a linked reference to the name like \nameref would do, but the first character is used in upper case mode.
